title: Prompt-Propose-Verify: A Reliable Hand-Object-Interaction Data Generation Framework using Foundational Models

bias_targets.methodology: Mitigating representation bias by explicitly prompting the language model to include diverse racial and skin tone descriptors (e.g., Light skinned, Dark Skinned, Asian, Indian, Latin) and evaluating their frequency distribution in the generated dataset.
Prompting the language model to generate a versatile array of prompts that explicitly model and include diverse genders to ensure proportional representation in the resulting image dataset.
